content.title: Implementation Methodology
content.content:
- SnapLogic Professional Services follows an Agile delivery model with 2-week sprint cycles

- Phase 0: Environment setup, Ground Plex deployment on OpenShift, connectivity validation (Weeks 1—2)

- Phase 1: Pilot integration flows prioritised with AH team based on business value and technical complexity (Weeks 3—8)

- Phase 2: Expanded use case delivery and team enablement (Weeks 9—16)

- Phase 3: Transition to AH-led self-service with SnapLogic support (Weeks 17—20)

**TO FILL: PROPOSED PILOT USE CASES**

*PS team to propose 2—3 specific pilot integration flows based on AH's stated priorities (SAP connectivity, data migration from Informatica, etc.)*
